intro.text: An ardent who served at the monastery in the Kholin warcamp on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Looking into Taln's disappearance, Dalinar learned from Kadash that the man had been in Insah's care, in the building where the mentally ill were held. In her hastily abandoned office he found a hole cut with a Shardblade and a blackbane-tipped dart, and, with Kaladin's help, opened her safe and took her records of Taln's treatment to Navani.
